big_case.notes: Formed before reading the candidates' big_case_score. PDVSA and Helmerich & Payne back at the Court a decade after Helmerich I, on whether the Second Hickenlooper Amendment's act-of-state exception reaches a damages claim where no expropriated property or proceeds entered the United States. A real but narrow statutory question in foreign-expropriation litigation, interlocutory posture, no amici, a response called for after waiver, then a bare denial with Justice Kavanaugh recused and no noted dissent. Significant to the sovereign-litigation bar and to this long-running dispute, well short of a headline case.
